$schema-note: TICGAL-wide GLPI plugin search-option ID registry. Search options are how a plugin gets a custom, non-blank 'field' label in a native GLPI Historical tab (Log::history()'s id_search_option resolves against SearchOption::getOptionsForItemtype()) — see the glpi-plugin-builder skill's 'History/audit-trail requirement' section and this plugin's ARCHITECTURE.md §3.7 for why these exist. This file exists to keep IDs collision-free BETWEEN TICGAL's OWN plugins (a mechanically checkable problem); it does NOT and cannot guarantee collision-freedom against third-party/public plugins — that can only be verified per-instance with tools/getsearchoptions.php --type=<Itemtype> against the actual target GLPI install before go-live. Workflow for adding a new option: (1) check no entry below already claims that id for the same itemtype; (2) run the collision check tool against a representative live instance; (3) add the entry here in the SAME change that registers it in code; (4) if this ever grows to cover multiple plugin repos, extract this file into a shared 'ticgal-glpi-conventions' repo and have each plugin vendor/submodule it instead of duplicating.
